Specification: This module is a small definitional test for custom infix operator aliases in TLA+. It defines several binary operators with different symbolic names and gives each of them the same body, namely the set enumeration {a, b}. The file contains no variables, actions, temporal specification, fairness, or proofs; it is purely a syntactic experiment about operator definability.
